test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which one of the following is the most populated district in India according to 2011 census?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thane**__.

**__Key Points__**
__

• According to the **2011 Census**, **Thane** district in **Maharashtra** was recorded as the most populated district in **India**. It had a total population of **1,10,60,148**, which accounts for a significant portion of the state's total population. ***Hence, this option is correct.***

• **North 24 Parganas**, located in the state of **West Bengal**, was the second most populated district in the country during the **2011 Census**. Its population was recorded at **1,00,09,781**. ***Hence, this option is incorrect.***

• **Bengaluru Urban** district in **Karnataka** recorded a population of **96,21,551**. While it is one of the most populous urban centers in **India**, it ranked third behind **Thane** and **North 24 Parganas** in the **2011** data. ***Hence, this option is incorrect.***

• **Pune** district, also in **Maharashtra**, had a population of **94,29,408** according to the **2011 Census**. It was the fourth most populous district in **India** at that time. ***Hence, this option is incorrect.***

**Additional Information__**
__

• The **2011 Census** revealed that **Uttar Pradesh** is the most populous state in **India**, with a population of approximately **19.98 crore**. In contrast, **Sikkim** is the least populous state with a population of only **6,10,577**.

• Among the Union Territories, **Delhi** is the most populated, while **Lakshadweep** is the least populated with a population of **64,473**.

• The district with the lowest population in **India** is **Dibang Valley** in **Arunachal Pradesh**, which had only **7,948** residents in **2011**.

• In terms of population density, **Bihar** is the most densely populated state with **1,106 persons per square kilometer**, whereas **Arunachal Pradesh** has the lowest density with only **17 persons per square kilometer**.

• The **literacy rate** of **India** as per the **2011 Census** was **74.04%**. **Kerala** topped the list with a literacy rate of **94%**, while **Bihar** had the lowest at **61.8%**.

**Important Points__**

• The **2011 Census** was the **15th National Census** of **India** since the first synchronous census in **1881** and the **7th** since **Independence**. The motto of the census was **'Our Census, Our Future'**.

• **C. Chandramouli** was the **Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India** during the **2011** operation. The census is conducted decennially by the **Ministry of Home Affairs**.

• It is important to note that **Thane** district was bifurcated on **1st August 2014** to create the new district of **Palghar**. While this reduced the geographical area and population of the current **Thane** district, for all competitive exams referencing the **2011 Census**, **Thane** remains the most populous district.

• The **Sex Ratio** in **India** according to the **2011** data was **943 females per 1,000 males**. **Kerala** had the highest sex ratio (**1,084**), while **Haryana** had the lowest (**879**) among the states.
